title: GreetCards — Template Surprise
objective: The card preview greets whoever you name. The application keeps a secret key in its settings — make the preview reveal it.

verifier.condition: The rendered card contains the application's secret key, which only the template context holds.

weakness: User input is concatenated into the template SOURCE instead of being passed as data, so template expressions in it are evaluated against the render context.
seededData: A small constrained template engine (data-only: no code, files or processes reachable) rendering with a context that includes app settings and a per-instance secret key.
hints: Does the page treat what you type as plain text, or does something interpret it? Try input that would mean something to a template language.
Look at how the occasion appears in the greeting. The same mechanism that fills that in may be available to you.
Template engines render against a context of named values. What would a developer put in there besides the visitor's name?
burpNotes: Try arithmetic or a simple expression first to confirm whether input is being evaluated, then explore what the engine lets you reference. This engine is a deliberately constrained, data-only evaluator: it can read what is in its context and nothing else.
